en.headline: Health officials raid beauty premises and seize unregistered injections
en.dek: Department of Health seized more than 100 vials of suspected Part 1 poisons and 20 vials of a product claiming to contain human tissue; a woman was arrested.
body: The Department of Health said it had carried out surprise inspections of four beauty service premises in Tsim Sha Tsui, Mong Kok, Tsuen Wan and Yuen Long as part of action against suspected supplies of unregistered injectable treatments.

Officers seized more than 100 vials of suspected Part 1 poison injections and more than 70 vials of suspected unregistered pharmaceutical products. Among them were 20 vials of Elravie Re2O, a Korean product packaged for injection and claiming to contain human tissue.

During a joint operation with police at the Mong Kok premises, a 38-year-old woman was arrested on suspicion of unlawful possession of Part 1 poisons and unregistered pharmaceutical products, and suspected commercial dealing in human organs. Controller for Regulatory Affairs Dr Fung Ying said the product is a regulated product under the Human Organ Transplant Ordinance and a pharmaceutical product under the Pharmacy and Poisons Ordinance. No exemption or registration has been granted. The department said the product lacks clinical safety data and poses a public health risk.

zh.headline: 衞生署突擊搜查美容院檢獲未註冊針劑 女子被捕
zh.dek: 衞生署檢獲逾100支懷疑第1部毒藥針劑及20支聲稱含人類組織的產品；一名38歲女子因涉嫌非法管有及人體器官交易被捕。
body: 衞生署表示，為打擊涉嫌供應未經註冊藥劑製品針劑療程的處所，連日突擊搜查尖沙咀、旺角、荃灣及元朗四間提供美容服務的處所。
行動中檢獲逾100支懷疑第1部毒藥針劑及逾70支懷疑未經註冊的藥劑製品針劑，當中包括20支名為Elravie Re2O的韓國產品，包裝標示用作注射，聲稱含有人類組織。
在與警方聯合搜查旺角處所的行動中，一名38歲女子因涉嫌非法管有第1部毒藥及未經註冊藥劑製品，以及涉嫌非法將人體器官作商業交易被拘捕。衞生署規管事務總監封螢表示，該產品屬《人體器官移植條例》下的受規管產品，亦是《藥劑業及毒藥條例》下的藥劑製品。目前未批出任何豁免或註冊。署方指有關產品缺乏臨床安全數據，有公共衞生風險。
